scenarios.name: Switch ribbon tabs with an expanded command context menu open

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user right-clicks Move Bodies in the additional area
its command context menu is visible
the Modify additional command area remains visible
the user clicks the Tools tab
the command context menu and Modify additional command area close
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user clicks the 3D Model tab
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Modify additional command area remains closed
